items.reason: Gap 0 describes a retry overlapping the first delivery with both jobs passing the set check before either inserts the id, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says the key comes from the X-Event-Id header, which the provider does not sign, and that a changed or forged header defeats deduplication.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the refund handler is registered under refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns concurrency among queue jobs in one process.
